Ingredient versions remain qualified, and serving accompaniment is distinct from recipe composition. items.caption: înghețată cu aromă de cacao
items.rationale: The restrictive noun phrase names cocoa-flavoured ice cream as a version of the destination, so the cocoa-to-ice-cream association is legible without defining every ice cream as containing cocoa. Both named concepts are ordinary Romanian food vocabulary; the caption introduces no additional intermediate or future route step. The existing forward edge accepts it and the missing reverse still returns no caption and rejects the hop. This is a quality judgment of wording and graph fit, not independent acceptance of the culinary evidence.

items.caption: chec în variantă cu cacao
items.rationale: The explicit qualifier în variantă cu cacao preserves the ingredient-variant scope: it identifies cocoa cake without suggesting that every chec contains cocoa. The short phrase tells a player why Chec is a meaningful first hop from Cacao and stays distinct from the ice-cream route. The existing forward edge accepts it and the absent reverse remains unavailable. Factual source acceptance is separate.

items.caption: înghețată în variantă cu lapte
items.rationale: The explicit qualifier în variantă cu lapte avoids universalising milk as a requirement for all ice cream. The noun phrase describes the same milk-based ice-cream version when read from either Înghețată or Lapte; it does not invert a verb or assert that milk itself is ice cream. Both graph-supported directions were exercised. It explains the final ingredient association on the ice-cream route without adding a route or exposing a later step at the opening. Culinary source acceptance remains independent.

items.caption: chec servit alături de lapte
items.rationale: Servit alături de describes a serving arrangement and clearly distinguishes milk as an accompaniment from an ingredient in the cake. As a noun phrase it names one supported way of serving chec; it does not say that cake must always be served with milk. This supplies an understandable final hop on the alternative cake route. Only Chec-to-Lapte is legal and the reverse was rejected with an empty caption. Whether the specific serving claim is source-supported is reserved to the factual review.

limits: Independent quality acceptance of the exact four-caption proposal. Acceptance does not establish culinary facts, final browser layout, natural selection or human enjoyment; distinct factual approval and final integration checks remain required.
